laws.why: Catatan di basis data menandai hal yang belum dipastikan; cocokkan dengan teks resmi.

laws.t: Implementing Regulations of the Labour Law

laws.tp: labor: Workers covered by the Labour Law (same exclusions)

laws.t: Regulation of Domestic Workers and Similar Categories

laws.s2: Berlaku bagi semua orang asing yang tinggal di Arab Saudi. Bersama UU Ketenagakerjaan, aturan ini menjadi dasar sistem sponsor (kafala).

Domestic workers: salary transfer through Musaned-linked digital wallets made compulsory in phases - 1 Jul 2024 new arrivals; 1 Jan 2025 employers with 4+ workers; 1 Jul 2025 3+; 1 Oct 2025 2+; 1 Jan 2026 all domestic workers (HRSD FAQ)
laws.s2: Majikan sektor swasta wajib membayar gaji melalui sistem yang tercatat. Untuk pekerja rumah tangga, gaji lewat dompet digital Musaned diwajibkan bertahap sejak 2024.
laws.why: Catatan di basis data menandai hal yang belum dipastikan; cocokkan dengan teks resmi.

laws.k: gcc|SA|Domestic Workers and Those in Their Position Regulation
laws.t: Domestic Workers and Those in Their Position Regulation
laws.o: لائحة العمالة المنزلية ومن في حكمها
laws.tp: domestic work: Domestic workers (14 occupations incl. home farmer, home guard, private driver). Replaces CoM Decision 310/1434; in force one year after issue (c. Oct 2024). Min. age 21 (Art. 6); max 10 h/day, 8 h continuous rest (Art. 10); 1 weekly rest day (Art. 11); 30 days leave per 2 years (Art. 12); sick leave 15 full + 15 half pay (Art. 13); employer bears recruitment costs, no passport retention (Art. 15); end-of-service 1 month per 4 years (Art. 22); worker may end contract with rights for abuse/breach (Art. 27); fines up to SAR 20,000 (Art. 29). Silent on freedom of association
laws.s2: Berlaku bagi pekerja rumah tangga (14 jenis pekerjaan, termasuk sopir dan tukang kebun). Umur minimum 21 tahun, kerja paling lama 10 jam sehari, dan satu hari libur seminggu.

laws.k: gcc|SA|Ministerial decision on transfer of domestic workers to another employer without the employer's consent
laws.t: Ministerial decision on transfer of domestic workers to another employer without the employer's consent
laws.o: قرار نقل خدمات العمالة المنزلية دون موافقة صاحب العمل
laws.tp: residence/sponsorship: Domestic workers. 12 cases for transfer without consent (e.g. 3 unpaid wages, no residence permit within 30 days, hiring out, dangerous work, abuse, employer stalling complaint or absent, contract ended in probation); final exit at end of contract. Implemented by HRSD rules (2024), which still cite the 2013 regulation. Updates an earlier decision (number not confirmed)
laws.s2: Pekerja rumah tangga boleh pindah majikan tanpa izin dalam 12 keadaan, misalnya gaji tiga bulan tidak dibayar, izin tinggal tidak diurus, atau mengalami kekerasan.

laws.s1: Laporan dan data UN DESA, sejak 2020.
laws.s2: Sekitar 281 juta migran internasional di dunia pada 2020, menurut negara asal dan tujuan.

laws.k: migration-law|P|Reports of the Special Rapporteur on the human rights of migrants
laws.t: Reports of the Special Rapporteur on the human rights of migrants
laws.tp: Thematic and country reports on migrant rights, including labor exploitation, detention and access to justice.
laws.s1: Laporan dan data UN Special Procedures, sejak 1999.
laws.s2: Laporan tematik dan laporan negara tentang hak migran, termasuk eksploitasi kerja, penahanan, dan akses ke keadilan.
laws.cit: UN Human Rights Council, mandate since 1999

laws.k: migration-law|global|HRC General Comment No. 15 on the position of aliens under the Covenant
laws.t: HRC General Comment No. 15 on the position of aliens under the Covenant
laws.tp: Covenant rights apply to everyone in a state's territory or jurisdiction, whatever their nationality. States may control entry and residence, but once aliens are admitted they keep Covenant protections, and expulsion must follow the procedural safeguards of Art. 13.
laws.s1: Tafsiran resmi komite perjanjian PBB tahun 1986.
laws.s2: Hak-hak dalam Kovenan berlaku bagi semua orang di wilayah suatu negara, apa pun kewarganegaraannya.

laws.k: migration-law|global|Protection of Migrant Workers (Underdeveloped Countries) Recommendation (R100)
laws.t: Protection of Migrant Workers (Underdeveloped Countries) Recommendation (R100)
laws.tp: Protection of migrant workers in less developed countries and territories during recruitment, travel and employment, including seasonal migrants: information, written contracts, wage protection, housing and welfare, and help for families.
laws.s2: Perlindungan pekerja migran di negara berkembang selama perekrutan, perjalanan, dan bekerja: informasi, kontrak tertulis, perlindungan upah, dan perumahan.

laws.k: migration-law|global|Recruiting of Indigenous Workers Convention (C50)
laws.t: Recruiting of Indigenous Workers Convention (C50)
laws.tp: Regulated the recruitment of workers in colonial territories for mines and plantations: licensed recruiters, limits on recruiting by public officials, medical examination and protection of families. Abrogated by the International Labour Conference in 2018.
laws.s2: Konvensi lama tentang perekrutan pekerja di wilayah jajahan untuk tambang dan perkebunan. Kini sudah tidak dipakai.

laws.k: migration-law|global|Migration for Employment (Co-operation between States) Recommendation (R62)
laws.t: Migration for Employment (Co-operation between States) Recommendation (R62)
laws.tp: Cooperation between countries of emigration and immigration on recruitment, information, equal treatment and bilateral agreements, an early model for today's labor agreements. Overtaken by the 1949 instruments (C97 and R86).
laws.s2: Kerja sama negara pengirim dan penerima tentang perekrutan, informasi, dan perlakuan setara. Sudah digantikan instrumen tahun 1949.

laws.k: migration-law|global|Migration Statistics Recommendation (R19)
laws.t: Migration Statistics Recommendation (R19)
laws.tp: Member states should send the ILO statistics on emigration, immigration, repatriation and transit, using shared definitions where possible.
laws.s2: Negara anggota mengirim statistik emigrasi, imigrasi, pemulangan, dan transit kepada ILO.

laws.k: migration-law|global|Social Policy (Non-Metropolitan Territories) Convention (C82)
laws.t: Social Policy (Non-Metropolitan Territories) Convention (C82)
laws.tp: Social policy standards for non-self-governing territories, with a part on migrant workers: safeguards when workers move within or between territories, protection of their wages and families, and equal treatment.
laws.s2: Standar kebijakan sosial di wilayah tidak berpemerintahan sendiri, termasuk perlindungan upah dan keluarga pekerja migran.

laws.k: migration-law|global|Discrimination (Employment and Occupation) Recommendation (R111)
laws.t: Discrimination (Employment and Occupation) Recommendation (R111)
laws.tp: Guidance on national equality policies under C111, including the bodies and measures needed to end discrimination in access to work, training and conditions of employment.
laws.s2: Pedoman kebijakan nasional untuk menghapus diskriminasi dalam pekerjaan, pelatihan, dan syarat kerja.

laws.k: migration-law|regional|European Convention on the Legal Status of Migrant Workers
laws.t: European Convention on the Legal Status of Migrant Workers
laws.tp: Recruitment, contracts, travel, residence and work permits, family reunion, working conditions and social security for migrant workers who are nationals of other parties.
laws.s2: Perekrutan, kontrak, perjalanan, izin tinggal dan kerja, reunifikasi keluarga, syarat kerja, dan jaminan sosial bagi pekerja migran di Eropa.

laws.k: migration-law|regional|Protocol No. 4 to the ECHR, Art. 4 (collective expulsion)
laws.t: Protocol No. 4 to the ECHR, Art. 4 (collective expulsion)
laws.tp: Bans collective expulsion of aliens; with ECHR Art. 3, it underpins European case law on push-backs.
laws.s2: Melarang pengusiran orang asing secara massal.

laws.k: migration-law|regional|Hirsi Jamaa and Others v. Italy
laws.t: Hirsi Jamaa and Others v. Italy
laws.tp: Italy's interception and return of migrants on the high seas to Libya violated Art. 3 ECHR and the ban on collective expulsion: states' duties follow their agents beyond their borders.
laws.s2: Pengadilan HAM Eropa memutuskan Italia melanggar hukum karena mencegat dan mengembalikan migran di laut lepas ke Libya.

laws.k: migration-law|regional|Council of Europe Convention on Action against Trafficking in Human Beings
laws.t: Council of Europe Convention on Action against Trafficking in Human Beings
laws.tp: Prevention, victim identification, a recovery and reflection period, residence permits for victims, and independent monitoring by GRETA, which has repeatedly reported on trafficking in agriculture.
laws.s2: Pencegahan perdagangan orang, identifikasi korban, masa pemulihan, dan izin tinggal bagi korban.

laws.k: migration-law|regional|EU Free Movement Directive
laws.t: EU Free Movement Directive
laws.tp: Right of EU citizens and their families to move, live and work in any member state, which is the legal basis for intra-EU seasonal farm labor.
laws.s2: Warga Uni Eropa dan keluarganya boleh pindah, tinggal, dan bekerja di negara anggota mana pun.

laws.k: migration-law|regional|EU Return Directive
laws.t: EU Return Directive
laws.tp: Common standards for returning irregularly staying non-EU nationals, including limits on detention and entry bans.
laws.s2: Standar bersama Uni Eropa untuk memulangkan orang tanpa izin tinggal, termasuk batas penahanan.

laws.k: migration-law|regional|EU Blue Card Directive
laws.t: EU Blue Card Directive
laws.tp: Entry and residence of highly qualified workers, with an EU-wide permit and easier mobility.
laws.s2: Masuk dan tinggal bagi pekerja berkualifikasi tinggi di Uni Eropa.

laws.k: migration-law|regional|EU Single Permit Directive (recast)
laws.t: EU Single Permit Directive (recast)
laws.tp: One application procedure for a combined work and residence permit, equal treatment with nationals, and a right to change employer, which reduces dependency on a single farm employer.
laws.s2: Satu permohonan untuk izin kerja dan tinggal sekaligus, perlakuan setara, dan hak pindah majikan.

laws.k: migration-law|regional|EU Pact on Migration and Asylum
laws.t: EU Pact on Migration and Asylum
laws.tp: A package of ten acts on screening at external borders, asylum and border procedures, Eurodac and solidarity between member states. It applies from 12 June 2026.
laws.s2: Paket sepuluh aturan Uni Eropa tentang pemeriksaan di perbatasan, suaka, dan solidaritas antarnegara. Berlaku sejak 12 Juni 2026.

laws.k: migration-law|regional|EU Anti-Trafficking Directive
laws.t: EU Anti-Trafficking Directive
laws.tp: Common definitions and penalties for trafficking, including for labor exploitation, plus victim assistance; the 2024 amendment adds forced marriage and illegal adoption.
laws.s2: Definisi dan hukuman bersama untuk perdagangan orang, termasuk eksploitasi kerja, serta bantuan bagi korban.

laws.k: migration-law|regional|Charter of Fundamental Rights of the EU, Arts. 15(3), 18, 19
laws.t: Charter of Fundamental Rights of the EU, Arts. 15(3), 18, 19
laws.tp: The right to asylum, protection against removal to serious harm, and third-country nationals' entitlement to working conditions equivalent to EU citizens' when authorized to work.
laws.s2: Hak atas suaka, perlindungan dari pemulangan ke bahaya serius, dan syarat kerja yang setara bagi orang asing yang boleh bekerja.

laws.k: migration-law|regional|OAU Convention Governing the Specific Aspects of Refugee Problems in Africa
laws.t: OAU Convention Governing the Specific Aspects of Refugee Problems in Africa
laws.tp: Extends the refugee definition to people fleeing external aggression, occupation or events seriously disturbing public order, and bans rejection at the frontier.
laws.s2: Memperluas pengertian pengungsi di Afrika dan melarang penolakan di perbatasan.

laws.k: migration-law|regional|Kampala Convention on Internally Displaced Persons
laws.t: Kampala Convention on Internally Displaced Persons
laws.tp: The first binding regional treaty on internal displacement, covering prevention, protection and durable solutions.
laws.s2: Perjanjian kawasan pertama yang mengikat tentang pengungsi di dalam negeri sendiri.

laws.k: migration-law|regional|AU Free Movement Protocol
laws.t: AU Free Movement Protocol
laws.tp: Phased free movement, residence and establishment across Africa. Not yet in force for lack of ratifications.
laws.s2: Kebebasan bergerak, tinggal, dan berusaha di seluruh Afrika secara bertahap. Belum berlaku.
laws.cit: Protocol to the Treaty Establishing the African Economic Community relating to Free Movement of Persons, Right of Residence and Right of Establishment

laws.k: migration-law|regional|ECOWAS Protocol on Free Movement of Persons, Residence and Establishment
laws.t: ECOWAS Protocol on Free Movement of Persons, Residence and Establishment
laws.tp: Visa-free entry for community citizens for up to 90 days, with later phases on residence and establishment; much West African seasonal farm migration moves under it.
laws.s2: Warga ECOWAS boleh masuk tanpa visa sampai 90 hari, dengan tahap berikutnya untuk tinggal dan berusaha.

laws.k: migration-law|regional|American Convention on Human Rights, Art. 22
laws.t: American Convention on Human Rights, Art. 22
laws.tp: Freedom of movement, the right to seek asylum, non-refoulement and a ban on collective expulsion of aliens.
laws.s2: Kebebasan bergerak, hak mencari suaka, larangan pemulangan ke bahaya, dan larangan pengusiran massal.

laws.k: migration-law|regional|Advisory Opinion OC-18/03: Juridical Condition and Rights of Undocumented Migrants
laws.t: Advisory Opinion OC-18/03: Juridical Condition and Rights of Undocumented Migrants
laws.tp: Equality and non-discrimination are jus cogens: once employed, undocumented migrants hold the same labor rights as other workers, whatever their status.
laws.s2: Pekerja migran tanpa dokumen memiliki hak kerja yang sama dengan pekerja lain setelah bekerja, apa pun statusnya.
laws.cit: Inter-American Court of Human Rights, 17 September 2003

laws.k: migration-law|regional|Advisory Opinion OC-21/14: Rights of children in the context of migration
laws.t: Advisory Opinion OC-21/14: Rights of children in the context of migration
laws.tp: States may not detain children for migration reasons and must apply child-specific procedures and non-refoulement.
laws.s2: Anak tidak boleh ditahan karena alasan migrasi dan harus diperiksa dengan prosedur khusus anak.
laws.cit: Inter-American Court of Human Rights, 19 August 2014

laws.k: migration-law|regional|Cartagena Declaration on Refugees
laws.t: Cartagena Declaration on Refugees
laws.tp: A broader refugee definition covering generalised violence and massive human rights violations, later written into many Latin American laws.
laws.s2: Pengertian pengungsi yang lebih luas di Amerika Latin, termasuk orang yang lari dari kekerasan umum. Tidak mengikat.
laws.cit: Colloquium on International Protection of Refugees in Central America, Mexico and Panama, 1984

laws.k: migration-law|regional|MERCOSUR Residence Agreement
laws.t: MERCOSUR Residence Agreement
laws.tp: Nationals of member and associated states can obtain temporary and then permanent residence and the right to work, with equal treatment.
laws.s2: Warga negara anggota MERCOSUR dapat memperoleh izin tinggal dan hak bekerja dengan perlakuan setara.
laws.cit: Acuerdo sobre Residencia para Nacionales de los Estados Partes del MERCOSUR, Bolivia y Chile

laws.k: migration-law|regional|ASEAN Declaration on the Protection and Promotion of the Rights of Migrant Workers (Cebu Declaration)
laws.t: ASEAN Declaration on the Protection and Promotion of the Rights of Migrant Workers (Cebu Declaration)
laws.tp: Obligations of sending and receiving states to protect migrant workers, without prejudice to national law.
laws.s2: Kewajiban negara pengirim dan penerima di ASEAN untuk melindungi pekerja migran. Tidak mengikat.

laws.k: migration-law|regional|ASEAN Human Rights Declaration, Arts. 15, 16 and 27
laws.t: ASEAN Human Rights Declaration, Arts. 15, 16 and 27
laws.tp: Freedom of movement and the right to leave and return (Art. 15), the right to seek and receive asylum in line with each state's laws and its treaties (Art. 16), and just and favorable conditions of work (Art. 27).
laws.s2: Kebebasan bergerak, hak mencari suaka, dan hak atas syarat kerja yang adil di ASEAN. Tidak mengikat.

laws.k: migration-law|regional|ASEAN Consensus on the Protection and Promotion of the Rights of Migrant Workers
laws.t: ASEAN Consensus on the Protection and Promotion of the Rights of Migrant Workers
laws.tp: Fair treatment, access to information, contracts, and the right to hold their own passports for documented migrant workers.
laws.s2: Perlakuan adil, informasi, kontrak, dan hak menyimpan paspor sendiri bagi pekerja migran berdokumen di ASEAN. Tidak mengikat.

laws.k: migration-law|regional|ASEAN Convention against Trafficking in Persons, Especially Women and Children
laws.t: ASEAN Convention against Trafficking in Persons, Especially Women and Children
laws.tp: Criminalization, prevention and victim protection for trafficking in Southeast Asia, including forced labor on fishing boats and plantations.
laws.s2: Pemidanaan, pencegahan, dan perlindungan korban perdagangan orang di Asia Tenggara, termasuk kerja paksa di kapal ikan dan perkebunan.

laws.k: migration-law|regional|Bangkok Principles on the Status and Treatment of Refugees
laws.t: Bangkok Principles on the Status and Treatment of Refugees
laws.tp: Non-binding refugee principles for Asian and African states, many of which are not party to the 1951 Convention.
laws.s2: Prinsip tidak mengikat tentang pengungsi bagi negara Asia dan Afrika.

laws.k: migration-law|regional|North American Agreement on Labor Cooperation (NAALC)
laws.t: North American Agreement on Labor Cooperation (NAALC)
laws.tp: Eleven labor principles, including protection of migrant workers (Principle 11), with public submissions to national administrative offices; several submissions concerned migrant farmworkers on H-2A visas. Replaced by the USMCA labor chapter in July 2020.
laws.s2: Sebelas prinsip ketenagakerjaan di Amerika Utara, termasuk perlindungan pekerja migran.

laws.k: migration-law|regional|Revised Treaty of Chaguaramas (CARICOM)
laws.t: Revised Treaty of Chaguaramas (CARICOM)
laws.tp: Free movement of skilled CARICOM nationals (Art. 46) and of service providers and the self-employed within the CARICOM Single Market and Economy. [Dates and link to be confirmed against the official source.]
laws.s2: Kebebasan bergerak bagi warga CARICOM yang terampil dan penyedia jasa. Tanggal dan tautannya perlu dicek.
laws.why: Catatan di basis data menandai hal yang belum dipastikan; cocokkan dengan teks resmi.
laws.cit: Revised Treaty establishing the Caribbean Community, including the CARICOM Single Market and Economy, 2001

laws.k: migration-law|regional|Inter-American Convention on Territorial Asylum (Caracas)
laws.t: Inter-American Convention on Territorial Asylum (Caracas)
laws.tp: Every state may grant asylum in its territory to persons persecuted for political reasons or political offenses, and need not surrender them.
laws.s2: Setiap negara boleh memberi suaka di wilayahnya bagi orang yang dikejar karena alasan politik.

laws.k: migration-law|regional|Inter-American Convention on Diplomatic Asylum (Caracas)
laws.t: Inter-American Convention on Diplomatic Asylum (Caracas)
laws.tp: Rules on asylum granted in embassies, warships and military camps for persons sought for political reasons, and on safe conduct out of the country.
laws.s2: Aturan suaka di kedutaan dan jalan aman keluar negeri bagi orang yang dikejar karena alasan politik.

laws.k: migration-law|regional|ECOWAS Protocol relating to the Definition of Community Citizen
laws.t: ECOWAS Protocol relating to the Definition of Community Citizen
laws.tp: Defines who counts as an ECOWAS community citizen, and so who benefits from the free movement protocols. [Dates and link to be confirmed against the official source.]
laws.s2: Menetapkan siapa warga ECOWAS yang berhak atas kebebasan bergerak. Tanggal dan tautannya perlu dicek.
laws.why: Catatan di basis data menandai hal yang belum dipastikan; cocokkan dengan teks resmi.

laws.k: migration-law|regional|ECOWAS Supplementary Protocol on the Right of Residence
laws.t: ECOWAS Supplementary Protocol on the Right of Residence
laws.tp: Right of residence for community citizens who take up work in another member state, with residence cards and equal treatment in employment. [Dates and link to be confirmed against the official source.]
laws.s2: Hak tinggal bagi warga ECOWAS yang bekerja di negara anggota lain. Tanggal dan tautannya perlu dicek.
laws.why: Catatan di basis data menandai hal yang belum dipastikan; cocokkan dengan teks resmi.
laws.cit: Supplementary Protocol A/SP.1/7/86 (second phase of the 1979 Protocol)

laws.k: migration-law|regional|ECOWAS Supplementary Protocol on the Right of Establishment
laws.t: ECOWAS Supplementary Protocol on the Right of Establishment
laws.tp: Right of community citizens to set up and run businesses in another member state on the same terms as nationals. [Dates and link to be confirmed against the official source.]
laws.s2: Hak warga ECOWAS untuk berusaha di negara anggota lain dengan syarat yang sama. Tanggal dan tautannya perlu dicek.
laws.why: Catatan di basis data menandai hal yang belum dipastikan; cocokkan dengan teks resmi.
laws.cit: Supplementary Protocol A/SP.2/5/90 (third phase of the 1979 Protocol)

laws.k: migration-law|regional|Revised ECOWAS Treaty
laws.t: Revised ECOWAS Treaty
laws.tp: Makes the removal of obstacles to free movement of persons, residence and establishment a treaty objective (Arts. 3 and 59).
laws.s2: Menjadikan penghapusan hambatan bergerak, tinggal, dan berusaha sebagai tujuan ECOWAS.
laws.cit: Revised Treaty of the Economic Community of West African States, 1993

laws.k: migration-law|regional|Abuja Treaty establishing the African Economic Community
laws.t: Abuja Treaty establishing the African Economic Community
laws.tp: A phased plan for an African economic community, including free movement of persons, residence and establishment (Art. 43); the parent treaty of the 2018 AU Free Movement Protocol.
laws.s2: Rencana bertahap komunitas ekonomi Afrika, termasuk kebebasan bergerak, tinggal, dan berusaha.
laws.cit: Treaty establishing the African Economic Community, 1991

laws.k: migration-law|regional|SADC Treaty (Southern African Development Community)
laws.t: SADC Treaty (Southern African Development Community)
laws.tp: Commits member states to develop policies to remove obstacles to the free movement of people in the region (Art. 5); the basis for the 2005 Protocol on the Facilitation of Movement of Persons. [Dates and link to be confirmed against the official source.]
laws.s2: Negara anggota SADC berjanji menghapus hambatan bergerak di kawasan. Tanggal dan tautannya perlu dicek.
laws.why: Catatan di basis data menandai hal yang belum dipastikan; cocokkan dengan teks resmi.
laws.cit: Treaty of the Southern African Development Community, 1992

laws.k: migration-law|regional|COMESA Treaty (Common Market for Eastern and Southern Africa)
laws.t: COMESA Treaty (Common Market for Eastern and Southern Africa)
laws.tp: Commits member states to remove obstacles to the free movement of persons, labor and services and to the right of establishment and residence (Art. 164), developed in a 2001 free movement protocol. [Dates and link to be confirmed against the official source.]
laws.s2: Negara anggota COMESA berjanji menghapus hambatan bergerak bagi orang, pekerja, dan jasa. Tanggal dan tautannya perlu dicek.
laws.why: Catatan di basis data menandai hal yang belum dipastikan; cocokkan dengan teks resmi.
laws.cit: Treaty establishing the Common Market for Eastern and Southern Africa, 1993

laws.k: migration-law|regional|ECCAS Treaty (Economic Community of Central African States)
laws.t: ECCAS Treaty (Economic Community of Central African States)
laws.tp: Provides for free movement of persons and the right of establishment among Central African states (Art. 40 and Protocol on freedom of movement). [Dates and link to be confirmed against the official source.]
laws.s2: Kebebasan bergerak dan berusaha antarnegara Afrika Tengah. Tanggal dan tautannya perlu dicek.
laws.why: Catatan di basis data menandai hal yang belum dipastikan; cocokkan dengan teks resmi.
laws.cit: Treaty establishing the Economic Community of Central African States, 1983

laws.k: migration-law|national|Law No. 18 of 2017 on the Protection of Indonesian Migrant Workers
laws.t: Law No. 18 of 2017 on the Protection of Indonesian Migrant Workers
laws.tp: Protection before, during and after migration; shifts placement duties from private agencies to the state; bans charging placement costs to workers; and sets up the migrant worker protection agency (now BP2MI and the Ministry of Migrant Worker Protection).
laws.s2: Perlindungan sebelum, selama, dan sesudah bermigrasi; tugas penempatan dialihkan ke negara dan pekerja tidak boleh dibebani biaya penempatan.
laws.cit: Undang-Undang Nomor 18 Tahun 2017 tentang Pelindungan Pekerja Migran Indonesia

laws.k: migration-law|national|Domestic Workers Protection Law
laws.t: Domestic Workers Protection Law
laws.tp: Recognizes domestic workers in law, with access to health and employment insurance, training, licensing of recruitment agencies, and a ban on agencies deducting wages.
laws.s2: Mengakui pekerja rumah tangga dalam hukum, dengan jaminan kesehatan dan ketenagakerjaan, pelatihan, izin agen, dan larangan agen memotong upah.
laws.cit: Indonesia, passed by the House of Representatives (DPR) on 21 April 2026

laws.k: migration-law|national|Law No. 6 of 2011 on Immigration
laws.t: Law No. 6 of 2011 on Immigration
laws.tp: Entry, stay, immigration detention and deportation of foreigners in Indonesia.
laws.s2: Mengatur masuk, tinggal, penahanan imigrasi, dan deportasi orang asing di Indonesia.

laws.k: migration-law|national|Presidential Regulation No. 125 of 2016 on the Handling of Refugees from Abroad
laws.t: Presidential Regulation No. 125 of 2016 on the Handling of Refugees from Abroad
laws.tp: Procedures for finding, sheltering and supervising refugees and asylum seekers in Indonesia, which is not party to the 1951 Convention. It does not grant a right to work.
laws.s2: Tata cara menemukan, menampung, dan mengawasi pengungsi di Indonesia. Tidak memberi hak untuk bekerja.

laws.k: migration-law|national|Migrant Workers and Overseas Filipinos Act of 1995
laws.t: Migrant Workers and Overseas Filipinos Act of 1995
laws.tp: Deploys workers only to countries that protect migrant workers' rights; regulates recruitment agencies with joint liability for employers' claims; and provides legal assistance abroad.
laws.s2: Penempatan hanya ke negara yang melindungi pekerja migran, tanggung jawab bersama agen dan majikan, dan bantuan hukum di luar negeri.
laws.cit: Republic Act No. 8042, amended by RA 10022 (2010)

laws.k: migration-law|national|Department of Migrant Workers Act
laws.t: Department of Migrant Workers Act
laws.tp: Creates a single department for overseas Filipino workers, merging the POEA and other agencies.
laws.s2: Membentuk satu kementerian khusus pekerja migran Filipina.

laws.k: migration-law|national|Immigration and Nationality Act
laws.t: Immigration and Nationality Act
laws.tp: The framework of US immigration law: admission categories including temporary agricultural workers (H-2A, from 1986), removal, and naturalisation. The 1965 amendments abolished national-origin quotas.
laws.s2: Kerangka hukum imigrasi Amerika Serikat, termasuk visa pekerja pertanian sementara (H-2A).
laws.cit: 8 U.S.C. § 1101 et seq. (1952), amended by the Hart–Celler Act (1965)

laws.k: migration-law|national|Immigration and Refugee Protection Act
laws.t: Immigration and Refugee Protection Act
laws.tp: Immigration and refugee law, including the Temporary Foreign Worker Program under which the Seasonal Agricultural Worker Program operates.
laws.s2: Hukum imigrasi dan pengungsi Kanada, termasuk program pekerja asing sementara.

laws.k: migration-law|national|Seasonal Agricultural Worker Program
laws.t: Seasonal Agricultural Worker Program
laws.tp: Bilateral circular migration scheme for farm work, with a standard employment contract, employer-paid housing and government liaison officers.
laws.s2: Program migrasi musiman untuk kerja pertanian, dengan kontrak standar dan perumahan yang dibayar majikan.
laws.cit: Canada–Jamaica memorandum of understanding, 1966; extended to Mexico (1974) and the Caribbean

laws.k: migration-law|national|Immigration Act 1971
laws.t: Immigration Act 1971
laws.tp: The basic UK immigration control framework: leave to enter and remain, deportation and the right of abode.
laws.s2: Kerangka dasar pengawasan imigrasi Inggris: izin masuk dan tinggal, deportasi, dan hak menetap.

laws.k: migration-law|national|Nationality and Borders Act 2022
laws.t: Nationality and Borders Act 2022
laws.tp: Differential treatment of refugees by route of arrival, offshore processing powers, and new offenses for irregular arrival.
laws.s2: Pengungsi diperlakukan berbeda menurut cara datangnya, dan kedatangan tanpa izin menjadi tindak pidana baru.

laws.k: migration-law|national|Skilled Immigration Act
laws.t: Skilled Immigration Act
laws.tp: Opens work visas to skilled workers with vocational qualifications; the 2023 revision adds a points-based job-search card and recognition partnerships.
laws.s2: Membuka visa kerja bagi pekerja terampil dengan kualifikasi kejuruan.

laws.k: migration-law|national|Consolidated Act on Immigration
laws.t: Consolidated Act on Immigration
laws.tp: Entry quotas set by the annual decreto flussi (with seasonal agricultural quotas), work permits, and special permits for victims of labor exploitation (Art. 22(12-quater)).
laws.s2: Kuota masuk tahunan (termasuk kerja musiman pertanian), izin kerja, dan izin khusus bagi korban eksploitasi kerja.
laws.cit: Decreto legislativo 25 luglio 1998, n. 286 (Testo Unico sull'immigrazione)

laws.k: migration-law|national|Organic Law 4/2000 on the rights and freedoms of foreigners
laws.t: Organic Law 4/2000 on the rights and freedoms of foreigners
laws.tp: Rights of foreigners, residence and work permits, and collective recruitment in origin countries (GECCO), used for seasonal strawberry and fruit harvests.
laws.s2: Hak orang asing, izin tinggal dan kerja, serta perekrutan kolektif dari negara asal untuk panen musiman.

laws.k: migration-law|national|Specified Skilled Worker system (amendment to the Immigration Control and Refugee Recognition Act)
laws.t: Specified Skilled Worker system (amendment to the Immigration Control and Refugee Recognition Act)
laws.tp: New residence statuses for foreign workers in labor-short sectors, including agriculture, with job-change rights that the Technical Intern Training Program lacked.
laws.s2: Status tinggal baru bagi pekerja asing di sektor kekurangan tenaga, termasuk pertanian, dengan hak pindah kerja.

laws.k: migration-law|national|Act on the Employment of Foreign Workers (Employment Permit System)
laws.t: Act on the Employment of Foreign Workers (Employment Permit System)
laws.tp: Government-to-government recruitment of low-skilled workers from partner countries, including for agriculture and livestock, with labor law protection but limited job mobility.
laws.s2: Perekrutan antarpemerintah pekerja berketerampilan rendah, dengan perlindungan hukum kerja tetapi pindah kerja terbatas.

laws.k: migration-law|national|Royal Ordinance on the Management of Employment of Foreign Workers
laws.t: Royal Ordinance on the Management of Employment of Foreign Workers
laws.tp: Regulates employers, recruitment agencies and migrant workers from Cambodia, Laos and Myanmar, with heavy penalties for unregistered employment and a ban on recruitment fees for workers.
laws.s2: Mengatur majikan, agen, dan pekerja migran dari Kamboja, Laos, dan Myanmar, dengan larangan memungut biaya rekrutmen dari pekerja.

laws.k: migration-law|national|Qatar labor reforms of 2020
laws.t: Qatar labor reforms of 2020
laws.tp: Ended the requirement for employer permission to change jobs or leave the country, and introduced a non-discriminatory minimum wage for all workers.
laws.s2: Pekerja tidak lagi perlu izin majikan untuk pindah kerja atau keluar negeri, dan ada upah minimum untuk semua pekerja.
laws.cit: Law No. 18 of 2020; Law No. 19 of 2020; Law No. 17 of 2020 on the minimum wage

laws.k: migration-law|national|Migration Act 1958
laws.t: Migration Act 1958
laws.tp: Visa system, immigration detention and removal. Seasonal farm workers come under the Pacific Australia Labour Mobility (PALM) scheme.
laws.s2: Sistem visa, penahanan imigrasi, dan pemulangan di Australia.

laws.k: migration-law|national|Migration Law (Ley de Migración)
laws.t: Migration Law (Ley de Migración)
laws.tp: Rights-based migration law: access to justice and health whatever a migrant's status, and a cross-border worker visa used for farm work in Chiapas.
laws.s2: Akses ke keadilan dan kesehatan bagi migran apa pun statusnya, dan visa pekerja lintas batas.
laws.cit: Diario Oficial de la Federación, 25 May 2011

laws.k: migration-law|national|Migration Law (Lei de Migração)
laws.t: Migration Law (Lei de Migração)
laws.tp: Replaces the military-era Foreigners' Statute with a rights-based law: non-criminalization of migration, humanitarian visas, and equal access to services.
laws.s2: UU migrasi berbasis hak: migrasi bukan tindak pidana, visa kemanusiaan, dan akses setara ke layanan.
laws.cit: Lei nº 13.445, de 24 de maio de 2017

laws.k: migration-law|national|Migration Law No. 25.871
laws.t: Migration Law No. 25.871
laws.tp: Recognizes migration as a human right and guarantees equal access to health, education and justice whatever a migrant's status.
laws.s2: Migrasi diakui sebagai hak asasi, dengan akses setara ke kesehatan, pendidikan, dan keadilan apa pun statusnya.

laws.k: migration-law|national|Immigration Act 13 of 2002
laws.t: Immigration Act 13 of 2002
laws.tp: Temporary and permanent residence, work visas, and employer sanctions for employing undocumented migrants, which affects Zimbabwean and Mozambican farmworkers.
laws.s2: Izin tinggal, visa kerja, dan sanksi bagi majikan yang mempekerjakan migran tanpa dokumen.

laws.k: migration-law|national|Law on the Legal Regime of Foreign Citizens
laws.t: Law on the Legal Regime of Foreign Citizens
laws.tp: Sets the rules for foreigners' entry, departure, stay and residence in Angola: visa types, including work visas, residence permits, the duties of employers and hosts, and administrative and judicial expulsion with detention pending removal. Resident foreign workers may join Angolan trade unions on the same terms as Angolan workers, but may not lead them (Art. 8 of the English translation). It takes effect 60 days after publication (Art. 125).
laws.s2: Aturan masuk, keluar, tinggal, dan izin tinggal orang asing di Angola, termasuk visa kerja.
laws.cit: Angola, Law 2/07 of 31 August 2007 (number and date to be confirmed against the Diário da República); repealed Law 3/94 of 21 January 1994

laws.k: migration-law|national|Emigration Act 1983
laws.t: Emigration Act 1983
laws.tp: Registration of recruiting agents, emigration clearance for workers going to designated countries, and Protectors of Emigrants.
laws.s2: Pendaftaran agen perekrutan, izin keberangkatan, dan pejabat Pelindung Emigran.
